milestone.title: M202 doc-overindented-list-items clippy lint — close the recurring false-positive at crates/mp-model/src/milestone.rs:155-158

intent.outcome: cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings is green from a clean baseline; the recurring mp-model doc_overindented_list_items lint (4 occurrences in M209/M212/M220/M222) is fixed once.

problem.description: crates/mp-model/src/milestone.rs lines 155-158 trigger clippy::doc_overindented_list_items with clippy 1.98+ (introduced during M202 cycle 3, commit 6204555). The reviewer correctly filed it as out-of-scope backlog against M209, M212, M220, and M222 — 4 milestones in a row. Each remediation cycle shipped with the lint still red. A 5-line reformat closes it for good.

in_scope: Edit crates/mp-model/src/milestone.rs:155-158 to fix the doc-overindented-list-items formatting (indented continuation to match the parent bullet).
Re-run cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings on a clean tree (make clean + cargo clippy).
Run cargo fmt --check + cargo test -p mp-model + the wider make test to ensure the formatting change doesn't break anything.
Add a CHANGELOG entry under the next release: 'mp-model doc-comment lint cleanup; closes the M209/M212/M220/M222 backlog pattern.'
out_of_scope: Refactoring the milestone-doc bullet that triggered this (the doc text stays the same, only the indentation/positioning is corrected).
Backporting the fix to other crates' doc comments.
